storage_timestamp_upgrade_source_candida.catalog: Exact expected table/column type, nullability and default catalog plus ordered partial action prefix; readonly serve verification.
storage_timestamp_upgrade_source_candida.upgrade_barrier: An explicit drained legacy_writer_role must be non-admin, non-owner and lack all storage CRUD/column privileges before v1 upgrade. Existing old sessions are tested independently. Fresh databases need no old role.
storage_timestamp_upgrade_source_candida.history: Original foundation source_commit/applied_at_ms are preserved; upgrade_source_commit and full-chain digest are separate. Unknown original timestamps stay NULL.
storage_timestamp_upgrade_source_candida.postgresql: Append DDL and metadata publish in one serializable transaction.
storage_timestamp_upgrade_source_candida.cockroachdb: Explicit ordered action blocks, catalog visibility check after each; legal completed prefix may resume, metadata publishes last.
storage_timestamp_upgrade_source_candida.rollback: No drop or mixed v1/v2 writer rollback; forward repair only after re-establishing the exclusive writer barrier.

storage_jsonb_upgrade_source_candidate.value_authority: One native JSONB value; object, array, string, number, boolean and JSON null history remains legal. HTTP writes retain object validation. No raw-byte read fallback.
storage_jsonb_upgrade_source_candidate.public_version: Independent native VARCHAR(32) token; generated ACK MD5 is over request bytes, never native rendering. Historical empty/opaque/Unicode versions remain literal.
storage_jsonb_upgrade_source_candidate.witness: Legacy Rust v2 bytes and new request bytes retain SHA256/MD5/native-render binding; unknown Nakama request origin has NULL raw pair and nonzero32-byte source-manifest binding. A real source-bound Nakama importer remains separate work.
storage_jsonb_upgrade_source_candidate.catalog: Closed typed actions, exact nullability/default/type/character typmod, named validated CHECK deparsers and primary-key order. No SQL splitter or silent repair.
storage_jsonb_upgrade_source_candidate.preflight: Entire keyset source scan before any persistent action; bounded 1MiB raw witness and 16MiB native projection. Reject illegal binary/UTF8/JSON/native numbers without data or metadata conversion.
storage_jsonb_upgrade_source_candidate.postgresql: SERIALIZABLE metadata lock and ACCESS EXCLUSIVE storage lock; native preflight, DDL, row backfill, complete postcondition and full-old-tuple CAS publish share transaction.
storage_jsonb_upgrade_source_candidate.cockroachdb: Native global preflight, exact ordered DDL prefixes, one-row SERIALIZABLE backfill transactions fenced by old metadata/row tuple, complete global postcondition, metadata publication last.
storage_jsonb_upgrade_source_candidate.history: Foundation source/time and all known/NULL storage timestamps unchanged; v2_apply_source_commit permanently retains actual prior v2 publisher, upgrade_source_commit records v3 publisher.
storage_jsonb_upgrade_source_candidate.rollback: Forward repair under exclusive writer barrier; no schema2 writer or destructive down migration after epoch3 publication.
